Notably, the fitting lines attained by back transforming the DRT data show a high degree of overlap with the original EIS data (Figures S4 and S5) except for the low- frequency region with a “diffusion tail” (Figure S6), proving the mathematic transformation almost has no influence on the information carried by the EIS data.

figures.caption: Figure S7. Schematic of the kinetic processes in ASSB. The arrows with different colors represent the distinct kinetic processes in ASSB. Black：Li+ conduction in the bulk/grain of solid electrolyte. Grey：Li+ conduction across the grain boundary of solid electrolyte. Dark blue and light blue: Li+ transport across the CEI and SEI from the solid electrolyte. Red: the charge transfer occurring at the surface of active materials. Orange: Li+ diffusion in the bulk of active materials.
